verdict.rationale: AWS documents programmatic access: the Cost Explorer API reference supports programmatic queries, the CLI wraps the service APIs with functionality equivalent to the console, and console credentials can be used for programmatic access. CloudFormation and CDK add declarative and code-driven control on top of those APIs, and an official MCP server exists for agent access. The OpenAPI probe 404s only show that no spec sits at those generic paths, which does not contradict the documented APIs. Missing for 10: evidence of a general per-service API reference beyond Cost Explorer, a machine-readable OpenAPI-style spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.
